articles.title: US Congressman says support growing for bill to stop Israeli settlements
articles.summary:
US Congressman says support growing for bill to stop Israeli settlements

Support keeps growing for the proposed Stop the Settlements Act, which would sanction anyone looking to take Palestinian land in the West Bank or Gaza, US Congressman Joaquin Castro has said.

"Since I introduced the bill alongside Reps. Dean, Beyer, Casar, Jacobs, and Escobar, over 50 members have now co-sponsored," Castro wrote on X.

He said settlement expansion pushes Palestinians "off their land and makes peace harder to achieve". 

"It’s time to use tools like sanctions to stop it," he said, posting the names of 10 new representatives who have supported the proposed legislation.

The Stop the Settlements Act would sanction anyone looking to take Palestinian land in the West Bank or Gaza. And support keeps growing. Since I introduced the bill alongside Reps. Dean, Beyer, Casar, Jacobs, and Escobar, over 50 members have now co-sponsored. Settlement expansion pushes Palestinians off their land and makes peace harder to achieve. Gaza health ministry says 1,501 Palestinians killed since October 2025 'ceasefire'

Israeli forces have killed a total of 1,501 Palestinians since the October 2025 “ceasefire”, Gaza's  health ministry says.

The toll includes three new deaths on Wednesday, including two Palestinians who died from injuries sustained in earlier Israeli attacks.

The ministry’s latest report said 17 people were injured in the past 24 hours, adding to the 5,323 injured since the October 2025. During the same period,  nearly 840 bodies were recovered from the debris of the devastated territory.

articles.title: Purpose of Genocide Convention is to prevent genocide, Navi Pillay says
articles.summary:
Purpose of Genocide Convention is to prevent genocide, Navi Pillay says

Former UN high commissioner for human rights and 2026 Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay has said that the purpose of the Genocide Convention is to prevent genocide, and countries are obliged to step in when they learn of any genocidal conflict.

In an interview with Sky News, Pillay reiterated call for prosecuting Israeli Prime Minister, president and former Israeli defence minister, either by national courts or by the International Criminal Court. 

"The purpose of the Genocide Convention is to prevent a genocide. The world doesn't want a genocide to happen and then react to it. Thousands of people get killed in these genocidal attacks. 

"Therefore, the focus of all states when they adopted the genocide convention is as soon as you hear that there might be genocidal conflict, you have to step in to prevent it. That's a legal obligation that rests on every state even if the genocide didn't happen in their own territory."

articles.title: Board of Peace plan stalled as Israel blocks Gaza outpost construction, report says
articles.summary:
Board of Peace plan stalled as Israel blocks Gaza outpost construction, report says

Israel is not allowing the construction of a key military outpost in Gaza that is part of US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, the Guardian has reported.

The board issued the contract in August to Louisiana-based Arkel International, which would build a base for 150 international troops that would serve as the vanguard of an international stabilisation force (ISF), the newspaper said.

Israel has yet to permit the contract to move forward, the Guardian reported, citing a person with direct knowledge of the matter.

Contractors and trucks are not being allowed to cross into Gaza to begin the work. “Israel won’t open the border,” the source said.

The Board of Peace, formed in the wake of an October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza, is central to Trump’s claims to have ended the conflict.

The source told the Guardian that without the contract, the rest of the Board of Peace programme cannot launch.

“You can’t get in without an international stabilisation force. You can’t rebuild,” the person said, according to the Guardian.

V Izraeli a Gaze mezitím pokračují cílené operace a incidenty, včetně přetrvávajících rizik spojených s nevybuchlou municí a pozemními střety na Západním břehu.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation remains critical due to escalating threats from Iran and its naval forces in the Strait of Hormuz, where tensions surrounding oil supplies are intensifying. Meanwhile, targeted operations and incidents continue in Israel and Gaza, alongside persistent risks from unexploded ordnance and ground clashes in the West Bank.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci napětí v okolí Hormuzského průlivu a zvýšenou nervozitu na trzích s energetickými surovinami. Bezpečnostní složky v Izraeli a na Západním břehu zůstanou v maximální pohotovosti.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of tension around the Strait of Hormuz and increased nervousness in energy markets are expected. Security forces in Israel and the West Bank will remain on maximum alert.

archive.security_status_cs: Izrael zvýšil úroveň bezpečnostní pohotovosti na maximum kvůli obavám z možné přímé a rozsáhlé konfrontace s Íránem. Vnitřní politická situace v Izraeli zůstává napjatá kvůli sérii obvinění ohledně selhání ze 7. října a blížícím se volbám, zatímco vojenské operace a střety v Gaze a na Západním břehu pokračují.
archive.security_status_en: Israel has raised its security alert levels to the maximum amid growing fears of a direct and large-scale confrontation with Iran. Domestic political tensions within Israel remain high due to fallout over October 7 intelligence failures and upcoming elections, while military operations and localized clashes in Gaza and the West Bank persist.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat extrémní ostražitost izraelských bezpečnostních složek a pokračující nervozitu na trzích kvůli hrozbě íránské reakce. Politické napětí uvnitř Izraele se bude před volbami nadále vyhrotit.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, extreme vigilance by Israeli security forces and ongoing market nervousness are expected due to threats of an Iranian response. Domestic political tensions within Israel will likely intensify ahead of the elections.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává kritická kvůli pokračujícím střetům v Gaze navzdory vyhlášenému příměří a eskalujícím námořním incidentům v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu, kde již dochází k potápění lodí. Konflikt nadále zatěžuje ekonomickou stabilitu a vyvolává obavy z širších regionálních dopadů na dodávky komodit.
archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation remains critical due to ongoing clashes in Gaza despite the ceasefire and escalating maritime incidents in the Strait of Hormuz, where ships are now sinking. The conflict continues to strain economic stability and raises concerns over broader regional impacts on commodity supplies.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující napětí v Hormuzském průlivu a zvýšenou nervozitu na trzích s ropou a hnojivy. Politická a bezpečnostní nestabilita v Izraeli a Gaze zůstane na vysoké úrovni.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued tension in the Strait of Hormuz and heightened nervousness in oil and fertilizer markets are expected. Political and security instability in Israel and Gaza will remain elevated.
